objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a 40-year-old woman who has presented with weakness and weight loss, and interpret her laboratory findings to make a diagnosis.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’ve been feeling weaker over the last few months, and I’ve also had some unintentional weight loss even though my diet and activity haven’t changed. I don’t have any urinary symptoms like pain or increased frequency, but I’m worried because there’s kidney disease in my family.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my skin or the whites of my eyes.” “I’m mainly just feeling weaker and losing weight without changing my diet or activity.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel stiffness in your joints when you wake up in the morning?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t really have morning joint stiffness—when I wake up I mainly just feel generally weaker, and the weight loss has continued.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling confused lately—like you’re having trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t felt confused or had trouble thinking clearly—I feel oriented and understand what’s going on. It’s mainly the generalized weakness and the ongoing unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been having **night sweats**—waking up during the night drenched in sweat or needing to change clothes or bed sheets? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had night sweats or needed to change my clothes or bed sheets.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a firm lump or swelling inside your thigh muscle (not just on the skin), especially if it’s getting bigger or is painful?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any firm lump or swelling in my thigh muscles, and I don’t have pain there. My symptoms have mainly been generalized weakness and the ongoing unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions or unusual spots along the veins on your arm (for example, along the inner arm where veins are more visible)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any skin lesions or unusual spots along the veins on my arms.” “It’s mainly been generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss without other specific skin changes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever worked in a job where you might breathe in metal dust or metal fumes—for example welding, grinding, cutting, machining, construction/renovation with metal, battery work, or working in a foundry or metal shop?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t worked in anything like welding or grinding metal, and I don’t have exposure to metal dust or fumes. I’m a school teacher, so my work is mainly classroom-based.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling or enlargement around your joints that feels bony or hard (for example in the fingers, knees, hips, or spine)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swelling or hard bony enlargement around my joints—my main issues are the generalized weakness and continued unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. Do you have pain in your thigh right now? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have pain in my thigh right now. It’s mainly generalized weakness and the ongoing unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this—can I ask: **do you experience pain or discomfort during sex (either at the entrance or deeper inside)?**
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had pain or discomfort during sex—either at the entrance or deeper inside. My main symptoms are still generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss without any urinary or other specific complaints.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any scattered skin lesions—like small bumps, spots, or sores—appearing in different areas of your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any scattered skin lesions like small bumps, spots, or sores appearing in different areas of my body. It’s mainly generalized weakness and ongoing unintentional weight loss.”
